newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rebound, other ports still dipping.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rebound, other ports still dipping.

text.p: ARA bunker prices rebounded on Wednesday with renewed buying in the morning, but prices in most other ports continued to drop in response to Tuesday's ARA losses, dealers said.
Many suppliers still had much product which could stifle the recovery that many players now expect.

Rotterdam 380 CST recovered to $102/$104 fob. Enquiries were healthy in the morning as many shipowners realised the bottom of the market had passed, but the main thrust for prices was in the barge market. One trading house was a particularly heavy buyer of product.
Total ARA traded volume rose above 10,000 tonnes.
"It hasn't been bad, but we were rather more optimistic in the morning," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices slid from late on Tuesday, dipping to around $110 fob.
Mediterranean bunkers, meanwhile, still had scope to skid further, prices in many ports falling by $3 to $4 a tonne. Shipowners were cautious seeing large avails in many ports.
Fujairah prices nudged above $90 fob, but few buyers were persuaded by offers at $92/$93.
